requirements.requirement: The system must render a board certification section within the provider scorecard inside MessageBubble when certification data is present.
The system must display a certification status badge (e.g., Certified, Not Certified) derived from the normalized logic output.
The system must visually differentiate certification status using distinct styles for positive vs negative states (e.g., color or icon).
The system must render the issuing body text exactly as provided by the normalized logic layer.
The system must display the certification’s contribution to the overall score in a human-readable format (e.g., +X points or included in score).
The system must position the board certification section consistently within the provider scorecard layout without breaking existing MessageBubble rendering.
The system must not render the board certification section if certification data is absent or null.
The system must render a fallback label (e.g., "Certification data unavailable") if certification status is missing but the section is invoked.
The system must handle long issuing body text without UI overflow by wrapping or truncating according to MessageBubble constraints.
The system must render the certification section within the existing MessageBubble component without introducing rendering errors or crashes.
The system must ensure the certification section is readable on all supported screen sizes (responsive within MessageBubble constraints).
The system must render the certification section within 100ms of MessageBubble render time budget under normal conditions.
